name: Glow text with light streak
what: One line of glowing gold text on a dark ground: the words light up one by one, then a small spark of light sweeps across the text with a soft streak behind it and rests at the end of the line, and later a few letters flicker like a failing neon tube.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f1-f8 (00:00:00:01-00:00:00:08) the first word fades up and its glow builds; f12 (00:00:00:12) and f24 (00:00:00:24) the next words do the same; f24-f34 a spark appears left of the text and brightens; f34-f56 (00:00:01:04-00:00:01:26) it sweeps across the text with a streak and a bloom and rests under the right end while the ground warms; f81-f89 and f180-f217 (00:00:06:00-00:00:07:07) single letters flicker; the rest holds
